name: Honkai: Star Rail Otome
source:
A short but sweet fan made visual novel where you play as the Trailblazer and set off on a potential date with your favorite Honkai Star Rail character.

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/hsr-otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款短小甜蜜的同人视觉小说，你将扮演“开拓者”，与自己最喜爱的《崩坏：星穹铁道》角色开启一场浪漫约会。

[摘自[url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/hsr-otome]itch.io[/url]]
